'''Dool Pundar''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation fleet/Legends|navy]] who deserted just prior to the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and became a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] lord. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he clashed with [[Breakout Squad]] and was captured.

==Biography==
===Trade Federation career===
{{Quote|I am Dool Pundar...and my Trade Federation affiliation is long expired. Shut down all weapons and prepare to be boarded by my droids. Resist, and you will die.''"<br />"''You won't get any fight from ''us'', Pundar. But be aware this freighter and its cargo are owned by ''Noggox the Hutt...'' and Noggox would sooner work ''with'' pirates than ''against'' them.''"<br />"''And Noggox should be aware...I am a ''very'' independent operator.|Pundar to a freighter [[Unidentified Klatooinian captain|captain]]|<ref name="Strange Allies" />}}
Before turning to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Dool Pundar was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Profit (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Profit'']], a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="Wizard" /> As the fleet began the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> he and a few allies aboard his ship sent out a distress call, altered course and hid within a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] far from the control of his superiors. Making use of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] he had reprogrammed, Pundar and his supporters gathered those of the crew still loyal to the Trade Federation and forced them into an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], ejecting them into [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Armed with his own force of several small support craft and battle droids, Pundar set himself up as a pirate lord.<ref name="Wizard" />

After the conclusion of the Naboo blockade, Trade Federation forces were unable to locate Pundar's "lost" ship. They discovered his treachery several months later, after he orchestrated several fast and lucrative raids on well-traveled [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] lanes, netting him more ships, crew and supplies. His forces included over one hundred [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] and several [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] light [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. Pundar eluded capture by fleets sent by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Trade Federation, as well as numerous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="Wizard" />

===The Clone Wars===
[[File:Pundar_in_denial.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Pundar at the time of his capture.]]
{{Quote|Captain! We've been boarded by a Jedi!''"<br />"''This is Dooku's fault! To the escape pods!|Pundar and a [[Unidentified Neimoidian pirate|crewer]] prepare to abandon ship over Fondor|<ref name="Strange Allies" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> he captured a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]] belonging to [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] near [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]]. Pundar spared the crew, allowing them to eject in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Later, Pundar and his ship, at the behest of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|ambushed]] Noggox's last [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], which was carrying [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brains, at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. Pundar launched twelve of his Vulture starfighters to attack. The freighter, piloted by the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] was deliberately crashed onboard the pirate ship to allow Kungurama to capture Pundar. The Neimoidian captain ordered his crew to abandon the ship, and he himself took a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. The ''Profit'' was impounded by the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] personnel. On Foless, he set down outside of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to avoid detection. He planned on rendezvousing with his associate [[Kuvuta Pindi]], who had stolen orphaned children to use as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Kungurama and his ally [[Gizman|Gizz]] had agreed to take Pindi, posing as the orphans' blind handler, to Foless, but the Jedi grew suspicious and chased after Pindi. He crashed into her [[Airbus/Legends|airbus]], which was piloted by Pundar, forcing it to crash. Pundar was then taken captive by [[Breakout Squad]] while Pindi was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
Dool Pundar was an exemplary pirate lord, ruthless, and a highly talented tactician. Like others of his species, he was a greedy individual, but he was unusually brave and willing to take risks to obtain wealth and holdings.<ref name="Wizard" /> He threatened resistance with death, but was also merciful.

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Dool Pundar first appeared in a [[Wizards.com]] [[Bounty Postings]] article, "Dool Pundar: Pirate Lord". He later appeared in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'' comic.
